channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike kills three Palestinians in West Bank’s Jenin
item.description: Israel's prime minister and defence minister praise the attack as Hamas calls for Israeli 'crimes' to stop.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill five people, including three from one family, in Gaza
item.description: The latest round of attacks comes as Palestinians across the strip continue to face severe food insecurity.

item.title: 6 months of war on Iran
item.description: The US-Israeli war on Iran has reached the six-month mark, with no sign of slowing down.

item.title: After six months of war, what have US, Iran gained and lost?
item.description: Many of the US president's goals remain unfulfilled, despite claims of victory.

item.title: Two killed in 'domestic violence incident' at school near Berlin
item.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old male suspect after an incident in which two people were killed near the German capital.

item.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
